The establishment, which once went by the name Zoma, has a 4-star rating. It is well-loved for its cozy ambiance, good coffee, and a vibe that appeals to college students and others. It is also recognized for its urban decorations, and posters promoting movies and local art events. Although it has been noted that the coffee is pricier than other places around State St., customers appreciate the change from regular chain coffee joints.
